_comment: Cloudflare Workers config. workerd is not Node: no @types/node here. Wrangler/esbuild does the bundling, so tsc is type-check-only (noEmit). Consuming worker packages must declare @cloudflare/workers-types in their own devDependencies (catalog:) - pnpm's isolated node_modules means a types package declared only here will not resolve from the consumer's typeRoots.
